opencode.note: Built-in harness. Optional here: it already uses LAZYDEV_OPENCODE_BIN and LAZYDEV_MODEL. version_argv defaults to ["--version"].

example-claude-code.note: Example only: these flags are unverified guesses and must be checked against `claude --help`. Not tested; do not assume it works.

codex.note: Verified on Windows with codex-cli 0.170.0 on small file-creation tasks, alone and mixed with OpenCode in one run. On Windows use the real codex.exe (for example under the global npm folder, inside @openai/codex-win32-x64), not the codex.ps1 or codex.cmd shim, because workers start without a shell. This version has no --full-auto flag; -s workspace-write is what lets it edit files. Not verified: larger tasks, other versions, macOS, Linux. Codex reports no token or cost data and the shell-command audit is skipped for it.

agy.note: Verified on Windows with agy 1.5.14 on small file-creation tasks (single and in parallel with other harnesses). Needs one interactive sign-in first (run `agy` once). Runs with `--mode auto`, so edits and safe commands are auto-approved and anything else is soft-denied with exit code 0: rely on the git diff and verify, not the exit code. No cwd flag; the runner starts it in the worktree.
